page.title: Search for pharmacies
page.description: See which pharmacies are open now anywhere in Barbados, find free or subsidised medication through the Barbados Drug Service, and filter by parish.
page.introduction: Find government and participating private pharmacies across Barbados. Covered medication is free at government pharmacies for eligible patients; participating private pharmacies charge a dispensing fee. Government pharmacies appear first.
page.eligibilityLinkLabel: Check who qualifies and what to bring
page.sourceDescription: Pharmacy details come from the Drug Service register and published pharmacy information. Participation that has not been confirmed is labelled separately. Call before travelling to check hours, medication availability and costs.

drugService.heading: Drug Service
drugService.description: If a pharmacy is refusing your Drug Service prescription, contact the Drug Service for help checking your entitlement.

finder.label: Pharmacy finder
finder.noScript: Call the pharmacies below to confirm opening times.
finder.typeDescription: Covered medication is free at government pharmacies for eligible patients. Participating private pharmacies charge a dispensing fee.
finder.prescriptionDescription: The colour of the prescription your doctor gave you. Yellow and green (GEHP) prescriptions are filled at government pharmacies. Call to check your medication is covered.
finder.openNowDescription: Uses Barbados time and listed dispensing hours. Pharmacies with unconfirmed hours today are excluded. Call before travelling.

location.unsupported: Your browser cannot share your location. You can still filter by parish.
location.success: Government pharmacies first. Within each group, open pharmacies come first, then those nearest to you.
location.permissionDenied: Location permission is blocked, so results are not sorted by distance. Allow location in your browser settings, or filter by parish instead.
location.unavailable: We could not get your location, so results are not sorted by distance. Filter by parish instead.
location.timedOut: The location request timed out. Try again, or filter by parish instead.
location.failed: We could not get your location. Filter by parish instead.

detail.metadataDescription: Opening hours, phone number and directions for {name}, {parish}, Barbados.
detail.noPhone: No number listed. Call the Drug Service on
detail.unknownHours: Opening hours have not been confirmed. Call before you go.
detail.holidayWarning: many pharmacies close or shorten their hours on public holidays. Call before you go.
detail.refusedDescription: contact the Drug Service if you need help checking your entitlement. Call
detail.whatsappLabel: Order prescription via WhatsApp (opens in a new tab)
detail.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to fill a prescription at {name}. I will send a photo of my prescription.
detail.callAhead: Opening hours and Drug Service participation can change. Call ahead to confirm.
detail.nonParticipatingWarning: This pharmacy does not participate in the Drug Service subsidy. Ask the pharmacy about medication costs before you travel.
detail.unconfirmedWarning: Contact the Drug Service to confirm this branch's participation before relying on subsidised medication here.

slips.heading: Prescriptions accepted
slips.introduction: Check the colour of the prescription your doctor gave you before you travel.
slips.unconfirmed: Drug Service participation is not confirmed. Call to check whether this prescription is covered.
slips.governmentAccepted: Accepted for selected medications. Call to check yours is covered.
slips.privateAccepted: Accepted. A small dispensing fee applies.
slips.nearest: Not accepted here. Nearest pharmacy accepting {colour} is {name}, {parish}, {distance}.
slips.whiteFallback: Not accepted here. Participating private pharmacies accept it.
slips.governmentFallback: Not accepted here. Government polyclinic pharmacies accept it.

hours.unknownToday: Today's hours not confirmed. Call before travelling.
hours.privateSlipWarning: Yellow or green (GEHP) prescriptions are not covered here. You would pay full price.

noResults.resetDescription: Return to the default list of government and participating private pharmacies.
noResults.checkPrescription: Check your prescription is accepted before you travel.
noResults.checkParticipation: Check participation and medication costs before travelling.

noResults.subsidisedOnly: Only government and confirmed participating private pharmacies were included.
